title: Inside THR and SAG-AFTRA’s Emmy Nominees Night Party With Top TV Stars (Photos)
summary: Top TV talent from shows including 'The Pitt,' 'Widow’s Bay,' 'Pluribus,' 'Hacks,' 'Abbott Elementary' and more attended The Hollywood Reporter and SAG-AFTRA's bash, presented by Snapchat and Waymo, on Sept. 12 at Chateau Marmont on September 12 in Los Angeles.
